headline: Refex Industries submits Q2FY27 results
summary: Refex Industries submitted machine-readable Q2FY27 results. Standalone revenue rose 36% YoY to ₹55,951 lakh, while consolidated revenue jumped 84% to ₹76,132 lakh.

headline: Sonata settles US $5.25 mn litigation with ex-promoter
summary: Sonata Software subsidiaries settled employment and stock disputes with former promoter Srinivas Veeravelli for US $5.25 million, releasing deferred payment obligations.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Bharat Forge, Titagarh, PWL in focus
summary: Bharat Forge rallies on defence orders and capital infusion, while Titagarh Rail Systems secures a ₹65 crore order. PhysicsWallah targets ₹10,000 crore revenue by FY30.

headline: Cyient board approves $10M investment by GlobalFoundries in subsidiary
summary: Cyient Ltd's board approved a $10 million investment by GlobalFoundries U.S. Inc. in its subsidiary, Cyient Semiconductors. The deal involves issuing convertible preference shares.

headline: Adani Group plans $120bn+ capex over next 5-6 years
summary: Jefferies highlights Adani Group's financial discipline, with plans to invest USD 120bn+ over 5-6 years, net debt/EBITDA below 3.5x, and borrowing costs down to 7.5% from 10% in 2019.

headline: CLSA maintains Outperform on Radico Khaitan, target ₹4909
summary: CLSA reiterates Outperform rating on Radico Khaitan with a target price of ₹4909, citing vodka as a structural growth driver with 2-3x unit profitability over whisky.

headline: United Breweries expands Kingfisher Smooth to Arunachal Pradesh
summary: United Breweries Limited launches Kingfisher Smooth in Arunachal Pradesh, targeting the mainstream strong beer segment. The brand offers a smoother taste profile at ₹80 for 500 ml.

headline: Blue Cloud Softech signs pact with Mahesh Babu Foundation
summary: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions and Mahesh Babu Foundation have signed a collaboration agreement focused on technology-led social impact in healthcare, education, and skill development.

headline: PB Fintech liquidates UAE unit Zphin Computer Systems
summary: PB Fintech has disclosed that its subsidiary Zphin Computer Systems and Software Designing, a sole proprietorship LLC based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, has been liquidated.

headline: India defence exports to exceed ₹50,000 crore target
summary: India's Defence Minister has proposed a 20% rise in defence capital spending, while defence exports are on track to surpass the ₹50,000 crore target ahead of schedule.

headline: India 10-year bond yield eases to 7.2693%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield declined to 7.2693% from the previous close of 7.2858%, reflecting a modest easing in yields.

headline: BASF India seeks shareholder nod for revised RPT limits
summary: BASF India Limited initiates postal ballot to seek approval for revised limits of material related party transactions with BASF affiliates for FY27 and FY28.

headline: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility eyes exports and listing
summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility plans to expand electric 3-wheeler exports to Southeast Asia and Africa, targeting 5% of its 1-million unit sales goal by FY31, with a possible listing in 18 months.

headline: Equitas Small Finance Bank eyes universal banking license
summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank has announced plans to pursue a universal banking license in 2027, aiming to broaden its range of banking services and products.

headline: India plans 162.5% duty on bulk Scotch whisky imports
summary: India plans to impose a combined duty and tax of 162.5% on bulk Scotch whisky imports amid an ongoing standoff over the India-UK Free Trade Agreement negotiations.

headline: Maize prices up 50%, starch makers seek import duty waiver
summary: Surging maize prices, up over 50%, have raised raw material costs for starch manufacturers as ethanol plants intensify procurement. Companies like Sukhjit Starch and Gulshan Polyols are seeking import duty waivers.

headline: UPI MDR rollout faces delays amid stakeholder conflicts
summary: Implementation of UPI Merchant Discount Rate may face further delays due to conflicts between the government, RBI, and NPCI, alongside merchant backlash and election timelines.

headline: Blackbox shares flag large trade at ₹879 on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 11,00,000 Blackbox shares changing hands at ₹879 on BSE, with a combined value of ₹96.69 crore, captured during the pre-open session.

stock_name: ministry of new and renewable energy
headline: MNRE flags revenue risk for power DISCOMs
summary: MNRE Secretary has warned that the rise in captive power generation and self-reliant energy solutions is straining revenues of power distribution companies, prompting utilities to reassess their business models.

headline: APTEL orders release of ₹12.98 crore for Beta Wind Farm
summary: APTEL ruled in favour of Orient Green Power's subsidiary Beta Wind Farm, directing APSPDCL to release withheld wind energy payments of ~₹12.98 crore including interest.

headline: India's biogas push to cut LNG import reliance
summary: India's focus on biogas and compressed biogas (CBG) aims to reduce dependence on imported LNG, lower energy import costs, and strengthen domestic clean energy output.

headline: Honda plans ₹2,400 crore India manufacturing push
summary: Honda plans to invest ₹2,400 crore to expand its manufacturing capacity in India, aiming to strengthen production capabilities and meet rising two-wheeler demand.

headline: SBI block trades worth ₹126.7 crore on NSE
summary: State Bank of India saw two large block trades on the NSE totaling ₹126.7 crore. The transactions involved over 1.1 million shares at prices near ₹1,150.

headline: Max Financial Services shares flag large trade on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 4,03,770 Max Financial Services shares on BSE at ₹1,407.00, with a combined value of ₹56.81 crore.

headline: Piramal Finance AUM hits ₹1.11 lakh crore
summary: Piramal Finance reports 5x growth in retail book to ₹1.11 lakh crore. AI initiatives cut opex-to-AUM to 3.48%, driving 210% YoY profit growth.

headline: Vintage Coffee promoters buy 39 lakh warrants
summary: Promoter group acquires 39,00,000 warrants via preferential allotment. Holding rises to 37.67% of total voting capital.

headline: Bhavishya Ecommerce raises stake in Ashnisha Industries to 5.34%
summary: Bhavishya Ecommerce Private Limited acquired 10 lakh shares of Ashnisha Industries Ltd on Nov 17, 2026, lifting its holding from 4.96% to 5.34% via open market.

headline: Tata Technologies hosts investor day Nov 19
summary: Tata Technologies Limited filed disclosures for its November 19, 2026 Investor Day. Presentations cover software, aerospace growth, and AI strategy.

headline: Interface Financial buys 1.46% stake in Regis Industries
summary: Interface Financial Services Ltd acquired 37.56 lakh shares of Regis Industries via open market, raising its holding to 6.45%.

headline: Arman Financial promoter acquires shares via transmission
summary: Ritaben Jayendrabhai Patel acquired 29,759 shares of Arman Financial Services through transmission following the demise of Late Shri Jayendrabhai Patel.

headline: Jaiprakash Power sets Dec 21 deadline for postal ballot
summary: Jaiprakash Power Ventures Ltd has set December 21, 2026, as the last date for e-voting on the appointment of Ravi Kapoor as Independent Director.

headline: Stylam Industries acquires 51% stake in Haripur Kraft
summary: Stylam Industries approved acquiring 51% of Haripur Kraft for backward integration. The deal, valued up to ₹22.44 crore, secures kraft paper supply for laminate manufacturing.

headline: Krishna GVK Hotels hosts analyst meet Nov 21
summary: Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited, formerly Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts, scheduled a physical analyst meeting in Bengaluru on November 21, 2026, under SEBI norms.

headline: Aurionpro Solutions wins ~₹100 crore order for AI data center
summary: Aurionpro Solutions secured a new order of nearly ₹100 crore from a global tech leader for an AI-ready data center project in southern India.

headline: Bharti Hexacom shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,02,488 Bharti Hexacom shares changing hands at ₹1,645.00 on the NSE, with a combined value of ₹16.86 crore.

headline: Orient Bell promoter buys 4,600 shares
summary: Mahendra K. Daga acquired 4,600 equity shares of Orient Bell Ltd in the open market on November 16, 2026, increasing his stake to 21.26%.

headline: Orient Bell promoter Sarla Daga buys 5,000 shares
summary: Promoter Sarla Daga acquired 5,000 shares of Orient Bell Ltd in open market on November 16, 2026, raising her holding to 15.55% of voting capital.

headline: Orient Bell promoter Madhur Daga buys 600 shares
summary: Madhur Daga, a promoter group member of Orient Bell Ltd, acquired 600 shares in the open market on November 16, 2026. His holding rose to 3,37,556 shares.

headline: Orient Bell promoter group buys 140 shares
summary: Mahendra K. Daga (HUF) acquired 140 Orient Bell shares in open market on Nov 16, 2026. Post-acquisition holding stands at 4,75,515 shares, or 3.22% of voting capital.

headline: SVF II Meerkat cuts Meesho stake to 5.18%
summary: SVF II Meerkat (DE) LLC sold 15.64 crore shares of Meesho Limited in open market deals, reducing its holding from 8.60% to 5.18% between September and November 2026.

headline: Rajeev Goenka HUF buys Gamco shares
summary: Rajeev Goenka HUF, a promoter group entity, acquired 12,199 equity shares of Gamco Ltd via open market transactions between November 16 and 17, 2026.

headline: Virinchi Ltd sees pledge of 24 lakh shares
summary: Green Fields Meadows Infra Private Limited pledged 24,00,000 equity shares of Virinchi Ltd effective November 17, 2026. The holding remains at 2.36% of total voting capital.

headline: Sodhani Capital raises Oasis Securities stake to 73.21%
summary: Sodhani Capital Limited acquired 350,100 shares of Oasis Securities Limited via open market on November 17, 2026. The acquisition increases the combined promoter group holding to 73.21%.

headline: Indegene joins Indo-UK Life Science Corridor
summary: Indegene becomes the first industry partner for the Indo-UK Life Science Corridor, collaborating with C-CAMP and Imperial College London to advance entrepreneurship and knowledge sharing in life sciences.

headline: Gamco promoter Rashi Goenka buys 10,000 shares
summary: Rashi Goenka, a member of the promoter group at Gamco Ltd, acquired 10,000 equity shares via open market on November 17, 2026. Her holding now stands at 16,17,717 shares.

headline: Armée Infotech secures 135 MW solar project with MSEDCL
summary: Armée Infotech partners with MSEDCL for a 135 MW solar project in Maharashtra valued at ₹1,629 crore, marking a significant renewable energy development.

headline: RMC Switchgears wins ₹18.51 crore contract from KRYFS
summary: RMC Switchgears has secured a ₹18.51 crore contract from KRYFS Power Components for manufacturing and supplying various electrical components over a 60-month period.

headline: Auro Labs promoter group HUF buys 1,500 shares
summary: Siddhartha Deorah HUF, part of the promoter group, acquired 1,500 shares of Auro Laboratories in open market, raising holding to 0.112%.

headline: Kusum Lata lifts stake in Laser Diamonds to 19.28%
summary: Kusum Lata and persons acting in concert acquired 195,250 shares of Laser Diamonds Limited on November 17, 2026, raising their total holding to 19.28%.

headline: Msafe Equipments promoter buys 15,000 shares
summary: Gaurav Ajay Kumar Kanoi acquired 15,000 equity shares of Msafe Equipments Ltd in the open market on November 17 and 18, 2026.

headline: Kokuyo Camlin faces ₹5.50 crore excise duty demand
summary: Kokuyo Camlin received a ₹5.50 crore excise duty demand from CGST Appeals Commissionerate, Jammu, regarding Samba unit refund claims under J&K exemption scheme.

headline: Msafe Equipments launches aluminium formwork at ACETECH
summary: Msafe Equipments Limited unveiled its new aluminium formwork vertical at ACETECH Mumbai 2026, targeting high-rise and infrastructure projects with reusable, engineered solutions.
